components: wasm3 40e42cc (interpreter, not counted as glue lines)
glue.description: OPA's own compiler (opa build -t wasm) plus the wasm3 WebAssembly interpreter (third party, MIT) built into RP2350 firmware with a host layer that supplies the module's six imports, drives the documented opa_eval ABI, and carries JSON in and out over USB-CDC; both compiled modules live in flash, one runtime open at a time

notes: OPA's WebAssembly module for this policy decided observe/r9 on the RP2350 (rp2350-arm) under wasm3, expected observe/r9: identical. Board evidence prismpath/comparisons/results/opa+glue/evidence/A3/opa_wasm3_rp2350-arm.json. The comparator reaches the MCU class through its documented compiler and a third party interpreter; the glue is 171 lines and about 1.5 h, within the section 4 budget, no trust anchor added. Memory on the board: 311636 B heap high water of 520 KB SRAM, 131072 B linear memory, 4910 us USB round trip. For scale, PrismPath's table image for the same policy is 224 B or 160 B under a 1.7 KB interpreter class.
